feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Medicinal cannabis producer Grow Group weeds out new funding
articles.summary: A medicinal cannabis producer which distributes products in the UK and two other countries has struck a multimillion-pound refinancing deal after deciding against an outright sale.

articles.title: FBI investigating Nvidia CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy - but insisted he is a "very honourable man".

articles.title: Retail sector charity refuses to back Poundland owner's boss
articles.summary: Britain's leading retail charity has refused to give its public backing to the executive at the centre of the Poundland insolvency crisis amid intense political scrutiny of the US investment firm's conduct.

articles.title: Steel tycoon Gupta secures deal to keep grip on prized InfraBuild asset
articles.summary: The steel tycoon Sanjeev Gupta has struck an eleventh-hour deal to keep control of a prized Australian asset after a long-running legal tussle.

articles.title: Thames Water agrees funding into next year ahead of looming deadline
articles.summary: The UK's biggest water company has agreed to a funding deal, allowing it to continue operating until autumn next year ahead of a November deadline.

articles.title: Funds giant DE Shaw in talks to back £7bn digital bank Monzo
articles.summary: An American fund management giant is in talks to lead a capital-raising at Monzo, the UK-based digital bank, which is likely to value it at over £7bn.

articles.title: Octopus Energy sparks COP31 dealmaking with new Asian fund
articles.summary: One of Britain's most valuable private companies is extending its global tentacles further into Asia by launching a renewables fund to coincide with the COP31 climate summit.

articles.title: Government considering banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
articles.summary: The government is seriously considering banning children from online sales platforms such as eBay and Vinted, the culture secretary has said.

articles.title: Poundland suitor urges Gordon Brothers to release funding to secure sale
articles.summary: The leading solvent bidder for Poundland is urging its owner to immediately release tens of millions of pounds of funding needed to restock the discount retailer's shelves and save more than 10,000 jobs.

articles.title: Police detective on his frustration with salaries and the burglars he'll never forget catching
articles.summary: If you've ever spent your morning commute daydreaming about starting afresh with your career, this feature is for you. Each Monday, we speak to someone from a different profession to discover what it's really like.
